operations_signals.signal: SMS consent language in the form implies manual texting for estimates and scheduling - a natural place for automated reminders and updates
Consultation-led showroom model with no online booking: every design appointment is booked by phone
Leftover 'Bridgewater New Jersey' template copy on the contact page shows no one reviews the site regularly

scores.reasons: High-ticket kitchen/bath work with a showroom and financing, and the fixes are quick (wrong-town copy, schema, profile, form); gaps are real but not catastrophic.

caveats: Google Business Profile panels opened in a limited/consumer view; on several profiles (WeatherSeal, Extreme Team, Biondo, Brunswick) the rating was visible but the review count was not rendered, so no count is invented.
Gold Medal Service was triaged but excluded as a large multi-location regional company; its entry is kept for completeness and should not be ranked as a prospect.

Two 'websites' in this batch are effectively dangerous for customers: biondoroofing.com now serves Thai-language gambling spam, and extremeteamconstruction.com does not respond at all. Both are findings, not typos.
Page titles were read from the live DOM and, where possible, cross-checked against raw HTML; where a DOM title differed from raw HTML (Hollander), the raw HTML was treated as authoritative.
data_gaps: Budget Drain & Septic: could not find any Google Business Profile, website or current confirmation of trading; all data is from unclaimed directories.
Revenue, employee counts and owner names were not available for any business; size signals are proxies (review volume, years trading, licences, locations) and should be read as such.
WeatherSeal's claimed '400+/500+ reviews' could not be verified against the Google profile because the count did not render.
No contact, quote or booking form was submitted anywhere, per the research rules, so form deliverability/delivery was not tested - only the presence and structure of forms is reported.
